finding: Exact AccountLease.run has no caller-controlled failover switch. Any failover-eligible exception reaches _switch_account; therefore Stage-B protected provider steps cannot yet enforce the V36/V40 invariant without changing account_pool.py.

candidate.compatibility: Default true preserves existing Agent rotation/failover behavior. Core may pass false only after strict provider-intent publication.
candidate.disabled_path: Record the failing selected account once, record transport outcome retry_scheduled=false when applicable, do not call _switch_account, re-raise the original error.

self_review.reason: The exact current run() does not call _record_failure before _switch_account for ordinary failover-eligible exceptions; _switch_account normally owns that accounting. The opt-out path must therefore record once before re-raising.
self_review.trust_rule_denial: Existing earlier special-case remains unchanged and exits before the new opt-out branch.
self_review.timeout: Existing asyncio timeout remains fail-closed and exits before failover logic.

stage_b.remaining: Wire V41 into exact server orchestration together with V34/V35 store: route/account acquisition before intent, strict intent, deliberate provider steps with allow_failover=false and outer foreground retry suppressed, canonical durable finalize, then cache/reservation/client projection.
